segments.text: I am 48 years old and I am training to dunk a basketball. The problem is I've never dunked in my entire life. And at my age, the risk of injury is five times higher. So, for the next few months, I'm training like an elite athlete to see if I can defy the odds. Welcome to episode one of Can Unk Dunk.

>> How are you feeling about all this? >> Well, the bad news is I have little fast-twitch muscle, stiff tendons, poor coordination, and slow force development. The good news, we have a plan. Three training sessions every week following a format designed for athleticism, timing, rhythm, and rate of force. [music] At 6 ft, 180 lb, my vertical will need to be around 35 in, which means I need to hit some key benchmarks, [music] like a takeoff velocity of 14.5 ft per second and a 0.2 second takeoff time. It's a crazy goal, but if I'm going to live forever, I might as well be able to dunk.
